name: All Fives
summary: A trick-taking variant of All Fours where trump 5s and 10s are worth points and first to 61 wins.
rules_text: 2-3 players use a 52-card deck. Deal 6 cards each in two rounds of 3. Flip the next card as proposed trump. Player left of dealer may accept it as trump or ask for a new one. If the dealer refuses to change it, that player scores 1 point. If dealer agrees, discard that trump, deal 3 more cards to each player and flip a new proposed trump. Repeat until trump is settled. Then play tricks: non-dealer leads, others must follow suit if able, else may play any card including trump. Highest card of led suit wins unless a trump is played, when highest trump wins. Winner leads next. After all cards are played, score captured counting cards: Jack=1, Queen=2, King=3, Ace=4, 5 of trump=5, 10 of trump=10, plus 1 per trick? Some versions. First to 61 points over multiple hands wins, high score breaks ties in same round.
